proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived and independently audited a sound complete covariance-model equivalence characterization for the published singleton-permitting blocked superclass, together with a canonical PDAG lift, shortest legal reversal paths, exact-once enumeration, and fixed-p statistical consequences. The official cold D0.5.G referee nevertheless assigned subfield because the rendered note did not expose the precise Corollary 5.6 citation beside a load-bearing lemma; that citation and an independent attestation are present in core.json, so the remaining issue is citation visibility rather than a mathematical defect.
tldr: Equal incoming coefficients encode communities of direct causes. On the published singleton-permitting blocked class, equality of full positive-definite covariance models is characterized by common skeleton and unshielded colliders, common repeated parent blocks, and fixed orientation across unequal endpoint block families; equivalently, states are linked by partition-compatible singleton covered reversals. The canonical CPDAG-plus-background-arrow representation yields exact-once state enumeration after \(O(p^3)\) initialization with \(O(p+m)\) delay, output-linear partition lifting, a sharp \(p!\) bound, generic fixed-\(p\) BIC component recovery, and simultaneous inference for the finite effect set. The revised open question charges the total explicit output length for complete class records, including all memberships, compact circuits, requested shortest reversal certificates, and the exact partition certificate. No deterministic output-polynomial or polynomial-delay compact rational-circuit identity or canonicalization algorithm has been established, so that question remains open.
gap: BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026 proves BPEC structural identifiability only after forbidding singleton edge-colour classes and explicitly leaves graphical and transformational edge-coloured equivalence open. Ordinary covered reversals ignore coefficient partitions, while partial homoscedasticity constrains innovation variances rather than incoming coefficients.
fill: The project derives the repeated-block invariant from the model tangent at the identity, proves by a sparse regression separator that reversed edges must join equal endpoint families, and combines these facts with monotone covered reversals to obtain an if-and-only-if static and transformational characterization plus its statistical quotient consequences.
